title_protection.quote: A person may not assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant," the abbreviation "CPA," or any other title, designation, word, letter, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant unless the person holds a certificate under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate, firm license, or license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate, firm license, or license under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, dishonesty, or gross negligence in the performance of services, including preparing false financial statements or failing to file own tax return.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraud, dishonesty, or gross negligence in the performance of services as a license holder, including: (A) knowingly participating in the preparation of a false or misleading financial statement or tax return; or (B) failing to file the license holder's own income tax return

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a certified person or firm to obtain a license within three years of certification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the failure of a person who is certified or required to hold a firm license under this chapter to obtain a license not later than the third anniversary of the date on which the person was certified or required to obtain a firm license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a licensed person to renew within three years of last obtaining or renewing the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the failure of a person who is licensed under this chapter to renew the license not later than the third anniversary of the date on which the person most recently obtained or renewed the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of Subchapter J (title and practice restrictions).
Violation of a rule of professional conduct adopted by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a violation of a rule of professional conduct adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of certificate or firm license of the person's partner, member, or shareholder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a revocation or suspension of the certificate or firm license or a revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew the license of the person's partner, member, or shareholder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, cancellation, probation, limitation, suspension, or refusal to renew by another state for reasons other than failure to pay fees.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a revocation, cancellation, placement on probation, limitation on the scope of practice, or suspension by another state, or a refusal of renewal by another state, of the authority issued by that state to the person, or to the person's partner, member, or shareholder, to engage in the practice of public accountancy for a reason other than the failure to pay the appropriate authorization fee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or voluntary consent decree concerning the right to practice before a state or federal agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a revocation or suspension of, or a voluntary consent decree concerning, the right of the person, or of the person's partner, member, or shareholder, to practice before a state or federal agency for a reason the board determines warrants its action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final conviction or deferred adjudication for a felony or an offense involving fraud or dishonesty.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a final conviction of or the imposition of deferred adjudication for an offense under the laws of any state or the United States that: (A) is a felony; or (B) includes fraud or dishonesty as an element of the offense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct indicating lack of fitness to serve the public as a professional accountant.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conduct indicating lack of fitness to serve the public as a professional accountant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the chapter, professional standards, or board rules by a license holder or non-licensee owner of a CPA firm.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a violation by a license holder or an owner of a certified public accountancy firm who is not a license holder of: (A) this chapter; (B) professional standards adopted by the board; or (C) a rule or order adopted by the board

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: An individual who meets the requirements of Subsection (a) and who offers or renders professional services in person or by mail, telephone, or electronic means may practice public accountancy in this state without notice to the board.

practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: An individual practicing under the privilege under this section, as a condition of the privilege of practicing without a certificate or license: (1) is subject to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; (2) must comply with this chapter and the board's rules; and (3) is considered to have appointed the regulatory agency of the state that issued the individual's certificate or license as the agent on whom process may be served in any action or proceeding by the board against the individual.

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: A certificate holder may perform attest services only in a certified public accountancy firm.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: An applicant for initial issuance or renewal of a firm license must show that a majority of the ownership of the firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights, belongs to persons who hold certificates issued under this chapter or are licensed in another state.

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board by rule shall provide for a peer review program to review the work product of a license holder or of the certified public accountancy firm in which the license holder is a member

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The board by rule may establish a reduced fee to issue or renew the license of a person who does not engage in the practice of public accountancy because of retirement or permanent disability.

retired_license_status_available.quote: The board by rule may establish a reduced fee to issue or renew the license of a person who does not engage in the practice of public accountancy because of retirement or permanent disability.

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A certified public accountancy firm that is not licensed in this state but is licensed in another state may practice in this state without a firm license or notice to the board if the firm's practice in this state is performed by an individual who holds a license under this chapter or who practices under a privilege under Section 901.462.

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: An applicant for issuance or renewal of a firm license under this section must register each office of the firm in this state and show that all attest services performed in this state are under the supervision of a person who holds a certificate issued under this chapter or by another state.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: An individual who is a license holder or practices under a privilege under Section 901.462 and who is responsible for supervising attest services or signs or authorizes another person to sign an accountant's reports on financial statements on behalf of a certified public accountancy firm must meet the competency requirements of the professional standards that apply to those services.

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: A license holder or a partner, member, officer, shareholder, or employee of a license holder may not voluntarily disclose information communicated to the license holder or a partner, member, shareholder, or employee of the license holder by a client in connection with services provided to the client

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: The following safe harbor language may be used by a person who is not a license holder without violating Subsection (b): "(I/We) have prepared the accompanying balance sheet of (client's name) as of (date) and the related statements of income, retained earnings, and cash flow changes in financial position for the (period then ended).

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: A person who holds a certification, degree, license, or other credential granted in a foreign jurisdiction that entitles the person to engage in the practice of public accountancy or its equivalent in that jurisdiction may use in this state any title or designation under which the person practices in the foreign jurisdiction

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: A certified public accountancy firm that is no longer in compliance with this section because of a change in firm ownership or personnel that occurs after the firm receives or renews a firm license shall report that fact to the board not later than the 30th day after the date the firm ceases to be in compliance and shall take corrective action to bring the firm into compliance. Failure to bring the firm into compliance within a reasonable time as determined by board rule is grounds for the suspension or revocation of the firm's firm license.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm may not provide attest services or use the title "CPA's," "CPA Firm," "Certified Public Accountants," "Certified Public Accounting Firm," or "Auditing Firm" or a variation of one of those titles unless the firm holds a firm license issued under this subchapter
